note: Limited-time moves from events. Never part of a Pokémon's normal moveset; the app shows them only while the window is open. Written by scripts/event-moves.mjs.

moves.text: Evolve Zorua during the event or up to 4 hours after to get Zoroark with the exclusive Fast Attack Sucker Punch.
Evolve Bisharp into Kingambit during the event or up to 4 hours after to learn the Charged Attack Kowtow Cleave.
